disclaimer.1: The Anti-Asian Hate Crime Tracker website is created and maintained by a group of volunteers for the sole purpose of raising the awareness of anti-Asian behavior that is happening on a daily basis.
disclaimer.2: We collect anti-Asian incidents from online public sources and provide hyperlinks (accompanied by titles and brief excerpts of the reports) that direct the reader to the original sources of information. We believe our use of any copyrighted materials is permitted as “fair use” under 17 U.S.C. § 107. If you have any questions or concerns with any such use, please contact us <1>here.</1>
disclaimer.3: We collect and aggregate the data with our best effort. The information herein is provided with the understanding that we are not engaged in rendering legal or other professional advice or services. In no event shall we be liable for any consequences whatsoever arising out of or in connection with your access to or use of the website.

report.title: Report an Incident
report.intro_p1: By sharing what happened, you help us document anti-Asian hate, raise public awareness, and build a stronger, more supportive community.
report.intro_p2: We are here to listen. We encourage you to report any incidents of hate, bias, or violence against Asian individuals or communities, whether you experienced them yourself or witnessed them.
report.intro_p3: Your safety and privacy are our top priorities. All information you provide is strictly confidential. We will never share your details with law enforcement or any third party without your explicit consent.
report.intro_alert: If you are in immediate danger or require urgent assistance, please call 911 immediately.
report.form_location_label: Where did the incident take place?
report.form_media_label: If you have any images or videos related to the incident, please upload them here.
report.validation_location: Please pick where the incident took place.
report.error_submit: Something went wrong while submitting the report. Please try again.
report.consent_p1: Thank you for submitting your report. We deeply appreciate your courage in sharing your experience with us.
report.consent_p2: If you feel comfortable, our team would like to follow up to hear more about what happened and offer our support. Speaking with you helps us better understand the impact of these incidents and strengthens the resources we provide to the community.
report.consent_p3: Any further communication is entirely optional, and your privacy will always be fully protected. Would you be open to being contacted by our team?
report.consent_no: No, I prefer not to be contacted
report.contact_thank_you: Thank you for submitting your report!
report.contact_intro: If you are comfortable, our team would like to follow up with you to learn more about what happened and offer our support. Your willingness to share further details helps us improve the accuracy of our data and enhance the resources we provide to the community.
report.validation_email: Please enter a valid email address.
report.validation_phone: Please enter a valid phone number (10–15 digits).
report.error_contact_submit: There was a problem submitting your contact details. Please try again.
report.success_thank_you: Thank you for submitting your report!
report.success_p1: Our volunteers are keen to learn more about the incident you reported. If you're willing, please let us know the best way to contact you. Your insights will help improve our information quality.
report.success_box: We truly value your willingness to share this information, as it plays an important role in enhancing our understanding and the quality of resources we offer to the community. We appreciate your support.
